_comment: thicket_keeps_fight's start: standing in witch_hollow at (2,3), directly south of thicket_line_den (2,2). BAND FIXTURE (COMBAT_BAND_FIXTURES = 10): warrior 10, no mage, melee_hit raised to 57 for warrior L10 -- same shape and same reason as flood_ledger_fight_start; the den is measured at t3_warrior10 in sim_combat_batch's thicket_line_den_t3_warrior10_solo cell. SEED: derived at 2, not 9. Both new cells measure ~0.81 win rate in sim_combat_batch, so roughly one starting state in five is a real defeat -- seed 9's state loses this fight in 2 rounds, seed 2's wins it. Found by the derive-then-verify loop (_derive_rng_state.gd prints the .state per seed; patch the fixture, re-run the canonical, repeat), the sanctioned procedure -- the roster and the gate window are untouched. Built from riverfarm_fight_start (the region's shipped baseline: post-mounting, door_awakened + riverfarm_attuned, so riverfarm_village/riverfarm_mill/witch_hollow/witch_hut all satisfy test_fixture_coherence MAP_REQUIRES). Adds blight_lifted + heard_price_of_a_favor + price_of_a_favor_reported: both v0.16 side quests hang their start option off price_of_a_favor_reported, so a save that has not closed 'The Price of a Favor' cannot see them. TRAP: rng_state is DERIVED (tests/_derive_rng_state.gd), never hand-typed; WISave restores .state directly and RNG_STATE_MIN_MAGNITUDE rejects small ints.
